title: Testing
explain: A test runs your code with known input and checks the result, so you find bugs before users do. `pytest` finds functions named `test_*` and uses plain `assert` statements. Run `pytest` after every change to be sure nothing broke.
exercise: Write `is_even` and three tests for it: an even number, an odd number and zero.
tip: Test the edge cases too: empty input, zero and negative numbers. Bugs usually live there.
